discoveries.title: Der Rote Knopf
discoveries.subtitle: I'm Just Pressing Buttons · Die Esse
discoveries.hint: Drive into the center of Die Esse beneath the LMF Forge Arch and press the giant red button — or honk on it!
discoveries.codexEntry: 'I'm just pressing buttons.' — Logge's motto since the very first 2020 version of lmf.logge.top. REC is a button. Play is a button. Your horn is a button. Siehste.

discoveries.title: Oilbert's Platform Runway
discoveries.subtitle: Oilbert's Adventure · 2025
discoveries.hint: Send your Bulli airborne across the green-and-orange jump chain in the Purpur Arcade quadrant!
discoveries.codexEntry: Before Bulli Drive went 3D, a brave little red-and-white VW bus named Oilbert jumped green and crumbling orange platforms dodging bombs and collecting golden wrenches (+100 pts) & double-jump wings.

discoveries.title: 15×13 Neon Reactor Arena
discoveries.subtitle: Bomberman Multiplayer · 60 Ticks/s
discoveries.hint: Enter the Neon Reactor Party Arena in NE and honk on the glowing cross-tile at center.
discoveries.codexEntry: Vanilla JS & Canvas, running the exact same deterministic 60-tick simulation on the couch and online across 6 arenas (Neon Reactor, Magma Foundry, Cryo Circuit…). Eliminated players return as stun-bombing ghosts as Sudden Death spirals inward.
discoveries.toast: CHAIN REACTION! Sudden Death Spiral Active!

discoveries.title: SB-1 Sudsblaster & Nether Portal
discoveries.subtitle: Voxel Blitz · 32-Player Browser Shooter
discoveries.hint: Drive through the glowing purple Nether Portal arch guarding the Sudsblaster Quarry!
discoveries.codexEntry: 15 weapons, 15 maps (including Dust 2 and ttt_minecraft_b5 with working Nether portals!), and the deadliest gun in Voxel Blitz history: the SB-1 SUDSBLASTER, firing rising soap bubbles that pop and shove opponents.

discoveries.title: Turm des Erzmagiers
discoveries.subtitle: Arcanum · 3D Fantasy Escape Room
discoveries.hint: Climb to the NE headland stone tower and honk inside the glowing rune circle (ᚠ ᛗ ᛏ).
discoveries.codexEntry: Two chambers, one exit, many dead ends. The Archmage locked you in while popping out 'nur kurz etwas Schwefel holen' — three hours ago. Don't forget the Dragon's Eye, Nixie's Tear, Phoenix Heart, and Brass Key (⚷).
discoveries.toast: ᚠ ᛗ ᛏ Runes Lit! Messingschlüssel ⚷ Unlocked!

discoveries.title: Kniffel Tulip Dice Meadow
discoveries.subtitle: Kniffel Multiplayer · Rapier 3D Dice
discoveries.hint: Park peacefully among the giant 6-pip dice in the NE tulip meadow.
discoveries.codexEntry: Kitchen-table Yahtzee brought online for 1–6 players with Rapier 3D dice physics, 25+ achievements, emoji reaction bubbles instead of chat, upper-block bonus at 63+, and an AI-generated tulip meadow backdrop.

discoveries.title: Weihnachtsnacht Twin Pavilions
discoveries.subtitle: BeatGuessr & Coop Sudoku · Dec 24/25, 2025
discoveries.hint: Roll right across the luminous 9×9 Sudoku floor grid between BeatGuessr and Coop Sudoku.
discoveries.codexEntry: Two complete multiplayer games shipped in a single Christmas night, less than three hours apart: BeatGuessr (660 songs across 66 years, 1960–2025) and real-time collaborative/versus Coop Sudoku.

discoveries.title: GeoGames StadtPin Compass
discoveries.subtitle: geo.logge.top · 10 Daily Geo Challenges
discoveries.hint: Stop cleanly on the giant red StadtPin compass rose off GeoGames Avenue.
discoveries.codexEntry: Ten daily geography rituals — GeoWordle, MapPin, Silhouette, Capital Streak, BorderRun, StadtPin, FlagQuiz and more — hand-audited down to Western Sahara's borders for an ambitiously competitive evening leaderboard.

discoveries.title: Kolpingtheater Ramsen & Rampenlicht
discoveries.subtitle: 68 Seats A–G · Deutscher Engagementpreis 2026
discoveries.hint: Park neatly on the A–G drive-in seating chart in front of Kolpingtheater Ramsen (no single-seat gaps!).
discoveries.codexEntry: Since 2020 Logge has built the website, 68-seat booking map (with single-seat-gap warning!), QR & Google Wallet tickets, rehearsal script app, and the Rampenlicht member card game. On stage in Creepshow (2026): Bote / Diener.
discoveries.toast: Platz D4 reserviert! Auf der Bühne: Bote / Diener.

discoveries.title: JP Poolparty Resort (#ff2d87)
discoveries.subtitle: Ramsen · Whirlpool, Laser & Busse
discoveries.hint: Honk beside the hot-pink #ff2d87 party pavilion and whirlpool on the NW coast!
discoveries.codexEntry: Pool parties, group trips, and a shared enthusiasm for buses — the annual Ramsen event powered by Logge's jpCore backend, a Mitbringliste, a new accent color every year (#ff2d87 in 2026), and 'a small easter egg or two (don't tell)'.
discoveries.toast: jpCore DJ Mode! A small easter egg or two (don't tell).

discoveries.title: ShareX Windows 98 Desktop
discoveries.subtitle: Three ShareX Concepts in One Day · ★1
discoveries.hint: Cruise past the colossal retro teal Windows 98 CRT screen north of Ramsen.
discoveries.codexEntry: On July 15, 2026 Logge built three ShareX website redesigns in a single day: Capture Engine (Three.js reactor), Afterimage Lab, and a playable Windows 98 desktop — the only one that earned a GitHub star!

discoveries.title: Voll-O-Meter Crooked Roadhouse
discoveries.subtitle: Party-Chaos · 0.00 ‰ Designated Driver
discoveries.hint: Stop responsibly in the 0.00 ‰ Designated Driver bay outside the tilted roadhouse in far NW.
discoveries.codexEntry: Logge's tongue-in-cheek mobile BAC estimator tilts and blurs its UI as Party-Chaos rises — strictly an estimate, never for driving! Launch day needed three fixes, including the immortal commit 'Fix BAC calc (again)'.

discoveries.title: PowerPoint Karaoke Drive-In
discoveries.subtitle: VW-Bus vs. Wohnwagen: Image First
discoveries.hint: Blast past the 'VW-Bus vs. Wohnwagen: Image First' gantry on PowerPoint Alley at 100+ km/h!
discoveries.codexEntry: 17 absurd German image-first slide decks (10 slides each) with Random Deck and Panik-Notiz — from 'Wal Timmy sprengen' and 'Spa in der Hölle: Businessplan' to 'VW-Bus vs. Wohnwagen: Image First'.

discoveries.title: Der Strahlschlaufenreaktor
discoveries.subtitle: Chemieingenieurwesen zum Anfassen. Mit Blasen.
discoveries.hint: Approach the towering 26 m glass chemical reactor in the SE Blau Lab at 70+ km/h!
discoveries.codexEntry: Interactive 3D process engineering simulator of catalytic hydrogenation (Nitrobenzol → Anilin) with Calderbank & Blenke correlations, Hatta number, 10× enlarged bubbles, 3× flow timelapse, and live cavitation warnings.

discoveries.title: Learn AI 3D Embedding Observatory
discoveries.subtitle: learn.logge.top · 68 Interactive AI Topics
discoveries.hint: Drive fast past the floating 3D Embedding Space Cube in the SE AI Campus (80+ km/h)!
discoveries.codexEntry: 68 interactive bilingual AI guides built around 'Learn by doing, not just reading': tweak temperature, run o200k_base tokenization live in-browser, orbit 3D embeddings, and dive into Mega-Kernels.

discoveries.title: MelodAI Karaoke Mixer Arch
discoveries.subtitle: Gesang raus. Du rein. · Demucs + WhisperX
discoveries.hint: Drive into the giant dual-fader mixer arch on the SE coast and honk your best solo!
discoveries.codexEntry: Open-source AI karaoke pipeline: Search → Download → Demucs stem separation → WhisperX word timestamps → LLM singable lines → Web Audio player with separate Gesang and Instrumental faders.
discoveries.toast: GESANG RAUS. DU REIN. — Fader at 100%!

discoveries.title: Codex Quota Beacon (W 25→175%)
discoveries.subtitle: Android 4×1 Widget · Uncapped Forecast
discoveries.hint: Climb the steep dirt Quota Ridge Trail in far SE to find a red progress bar escaping its frame!
discoveries.codexEntry: Logge's Kotlin Android 4×1 homescreen widget monitors Codex usage across accounts using projected = used% × D / elapsed — intentionally never capped at 100%, proudly warning W 25→175% (+11pp)!

discoveries.title: Transcripator PoW Bunker
discoveries.subtitle: SHA-256 Proof-of-Work · 0000… Verified
discoveries.hint: Stop for 2 seconds in Transcripator Canyon so your Bulli can mine a 4-zero SHA-256 nonce.
discoveries.codexEntry: Audio in, cleaned transcript + summary out. Started as a Telegram bot in 2024; the web app skips CAPTCHAs entirely by quietly mining ~65,000 SHA-256 hashes in a Web Worker until four leading zeros appear.

discoveries.title: Mount Aftermovie & FI-Toaster-Schrein
discoveries.subtitle: 7 Ski Aftermovies (2019–2026) · Summit Peak
discoveries.hint: Conquer the winding summit of Mount Aftermovie in SW to discover the legendary FI-Toaster Shrine!
discoveries.codexEntry: Seven winter aftermovies from Feldberg 2019 to vertical 9:16 Portes du Soleil 2026 — honoring Bad Gastein's 50 fps Flowframes cut, Flachau's 'nach dem Sturz lief es wie wild', and Ski 2023's legendary FI-Toaster & invisible baking trays.
discoveries.toast: Grüße an den FI-Toaster und die unsichtbaren Backbleche!

discoveries.title: Die Chroniken von Selantis
discoveries.subtitle: Palatina Films (2015–2020) · Harras
discoveries.hint: Launch across the wooden drawbridge kicker through the ruined Selantis castle archway on the SW coast!
discoveries.codexEntry: Planned as a medieval short in 2015, snowballed into a two-hour fantasy trilogy with Logge on VFX, homepage duty ('We bring you fantasy'), and starring as Harras in Part 3. The 2018 website README still promises a redesign in 'Anfangs 2019'.
discoveries.toast: PALATINA FILMS! Harras clears the Selantis Arch!

discoveries.title: Abseits der Tabs & IJsselmeer Pier
discoveries.subtitle: 77 Night Photos · Blue Sailboat · AE Test (2014)
discoveries.hint: Cruise out to the very tip of the wooden IJsselmeer Pier beside the moored blue sailboat.
discoveries.codexEntry: 77 handheld night photos shot across 17 autumn nights in 2020 between 20:00 and 02:00 (01A–77A), overlooking the blue sailboat from Segeln 2019 & 2022 and a plaque for Logge's very first YouTube upload: 'AE Test' (7 seconds, Nov 22, 2014).

discoveries.title: Bands Amphitheater & spotifrei.db
discoveries.subtitle: 437,138 Plays · 22,476 Hours · Sonic Noir → Setlist → Bands
discoveries.hint: Pull up to the SW Festival Stage along Bands Promenade and honk for an encore!
discoveries.codexEntry: 437,138 plays and 22,476 hours of music since Oct 2017 — 497-day listening streak, peak hour 21:00, fueled by Swiss & Die Andern, Alligatoah, Linkin Park, Kraftklub, and KAFFKIEZ (45× in one day). Formerly Sonic Noir, then Setlist, now Bands — right beside LoggeRythm's spotifrei.db.
